title: Heidelberg — Neckarwiese, Alte Brücke & Schlossblick
tip: Philosophenweg via road from Neuenheim — never Schlangenweg stairs.
discipline_note: E-bike helps on the Schloss climb; path is shared with joggers — easy pace by the Neckar.

start_area.corridor_note: Tram/bus hub Bismarckplatz; Neckar Valley Cycle Path access in <2 min

short_pitch: Neckar path, Alte Brücke postcard, then an e-bike climb to Schloss and Merianausblick — Heidelberg’s real after-work loop.

pois.name: Theodor-Heuss-Brücke / Bismarckplatz
pois.why_good: Bike lanes off the bridge drop you onto the Neuenheim meadows without Altstadt cobbles.

pois.name: Neckarwiese
pois.why_good: Wide lawn + paved Neckar path between Heuss and Ernst-Walz bridges — best flat warm-up stretch.

pois.name: Kiosk do Bairro / Café Bairro Neuenheim
pois.why_good: Coffee at the meadow kiosk or Marktplatz café without leaving the north-bank flow.

pois.name: Philosophengärtchen / Merianausblick
pois.why_good: Castle–Altstadt–Neckar panorama; paved Philosophenweg from Neuenheim only — Schlangenweg is steps.

pois.name: Alte Brücke (Karl-Theodor-Brücke)
pois.why_good: 1788 bridge + Brückenaffe; roll across for the classic photo, then climb or return west.

pois.name: Heidelberger Schloss
pois.why_good: Steep road climb (~10–12%); e-bike friendly, terrace view over the valley before dropping back.

pois.name: Marstallcafé / Uni-Hof
pois.why_good: Last coffee option before Bismarckplatz if you skip the Schloss climb and stay riverside.

title: Mannheim — Schloss, Rheinpromenade & Waldpark
tip: Stay on paved park paths — Reißinsel core NSG is no-bike.
discipline_note: Almost flat asphalt/city; fine on any bike. Expect promenade walkers on weekends.

start_area.corridor_note: Schloss / Hauptbahnhof short hop; Rhine path via Lindenhof

short_pitch: Flat palace-to-Rhine spin: Stephanienufer, Waldpark floodplain paths, Strandbad stop — Quadratestadt nature without leaving town.

pois.name: Mannheimer Schloss
pois.why_good: Baroque Ehrenhof is the natural start before dropping south to the Rhine.

pois.name: Wasserturm Friedrichsplatz
pois.why_good: Art Nouveau city pin — clip it before the Lindenhof descent to the water.

pois.name: Rheinpromenade / Stephanienufer
pois.why_good: Tree-lined Rhine bank with ship traffic; continuous bike-friendly asphalt.

pois.name: Waldpark Mannheim
pois.why_good: Floodplain forest where promenade turns quiet — stay on signed paved paths.

pois.name: Bellenkrappen (Reißinsel edge)
pois.why_good: Old Rhine arm views; bikes stay outside the Reißinsel core reserve.

pois.name: PURiNO Strandbad am Rhein
pois.why_good: Stilt restaurant at Strandbadweg 1 — reliable post-ride food before the city return.

pois.name: Kurt-Schumacher-Brücke approach
pois.why_good: Clear return corridor toward Schloss / Hbf without guessing Quadrate one-ways.

title: Heidelberg foothills — Boxberg, Bierhelderhof & Gaisberg gravel
tip: Rohrbach S-Bahn start — skip full Königstuhl summit today.
discipline_note: Compacted Forstwege, not technical MTB. Wet leaves in autumn get slick; winter ice on north slopes.

start_area.corridor_note: S-Bahn Heidelberg-Kirchheim/Rohrbach on Wiesloch–HD line — best Nähe staging for Wiesloch testers

short_pitch: Königstuhl foothills without the 700 hm sufferfest: Rohrbach S-Bahn → Boxberg gravel → Bierhelderhof → Gaisberg tower.

pois.name: Heidelberg-Kirchheim/Rohrbach Bahnhof
pois.why_good: S-Bahn on the Wiesloch line — park-and-ride / train staging that makes this loop actually near the corridor.

pois.name: Boxberg forest roads
pois.why_good: Entry to compacted Forstwege toward Kohlhof/Gaisberg — gravel feel without singletrack legality drama.

pois.name: Bierhelderhof
pois.why_good: Farm-inn clearing ~260 m with beer garden and Hofladen — natural mid-loop reset.

pois.name: Ehrenfriedhof Heidelberg
pois.why_good: Quiet hillside memorial on the Speyerer-Hof approach — landmark on the forest grid.

pois.name: Gaisbergturm & Mammutbäume
pois.why_good: 376 m tower + 1870s sequoias; Rhine-plain view is the payoff before descending to Rohrbach.

pois.name: Kohlhof junction (turnback option)
pois.why_good: If legs fade, bail downhill to Rohrbach here instead of tagging the tower — still a solid 55-min loop.
